headlines.title: Customers report difficulty accessing online Chase accounts
headlines.description: Some customers are reporting issues with Chase banking services online and at some branches in person. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports on the latest developments as officials investigate the cause.

headlines.title: Trump says he ‘would not mind’ if Jensen Huang returned to lead Nvidia
headlines.description: President Trump said he “wouldn’t mind” if Jensen Huang were reinstated as CEO of Nvidia after he was ousted following allegations of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy. NBC News’ Garrett Haake details what tech leaders are saying about the scandal.

headlines.title: Trump blames FAA's nationwide ground stop on 'old equipment'
headlines.description: President Trump blamed the Federal Aviation Administration's nationwide ground stop on "old equipment" and stood by Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy's response to the incident.

headlines.title: Robert Pattinson named as the newest James Bond
headlines.description: Actor Robert Pattinson has been tapped to take on the role of James Bond as Amazon MGM Studios seeks to continue the blockbuster film franchise.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy to face retrial for the killings of her three children
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy will be tried for the second time for the killing of her three children in 2023. Clancy's first trial ended in a mistrial. NBC News’ Steven Romo and Danny Cevallos detail the next steps in this high-profile case.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: California sues ChatGPT maker OpenAI over rogue hacking incidents
headlines.description: California Attorney General Rob Bonta filed a sweeping lawsuit against OpenAI on Monday, alleging the technology giant jeopardized public safety by creating AI models “without the safeguards and monitoring necessary to adequately protect” people.
